snowRouteSourceNote: Snow Route Parking Restrictions (144 segments, 609 mi, every row restrict_t = '2 INCH'); the city's 2-inch ban list. ArcGIS layer 50 'Main Snow Routes' is 1,815 mi of plow routes, not the ban. See docs/DATA-FACTS.md.
closureRedPatternNote: streetclosure values on 2026-10-11: Curblane, Full, Partial, Intermitte, Sidewalk. Sidewalk never matches.
sundayHoursNote: SUNDAY_HOURS=Y means meters are enforced on Sundays (Loop/CBD and the opt-out retail strips); N means free Sundays. See docs/DATA-FACTS.md.
